summary.critical_pattern: ALL 23 rewrites share the same root cause: the short (morning) tweets for odd-numbered tweet IDs systematically pull quotes from Chapter 13 (Kshetra-Kshetrajna Yoga) instead of the correct chapter content. This appears to be a generation bug where the short tweet generator used a Chapter 13 verse index offset. The long (evening) tweets are consistently accurate.
summary.accuracy_issues: 23 tweets have verse misattributions — quotes attributed to Ch 14-17 actually belong to Ch 12-15. The short tweets appear to draw from a different verse lookup than the long tweets.
summary.voice_issues: Several long tweets that pass accuracy are still dense and scholarly. 4 flagged for simplification.
